ui.ACCEPT_TO_SHARE: Accept this quest to share it with your group.
ui.ALL_DUNGEONS_HIDDEN: All dungeons are hidden. Click Hide Dungeons to restore them.
ui.BUG_REPORT_TEXT: Found some wrong information or new discoveries that should be added? Please report it on the Discord, Screenshot required.
ui.CHAIN_PICK_ONE: You just need 1 of the following quests:
ui.FOREVER_FILTER_ON: Showing only WoW Forever dungeons. Click to show all dungeons again.
ui.FOREVER_FILTER_TIP: Click to show only the dungeons that are new in WoW Forever.
ui.GUIDE_TIP: Click to show the steps to complete this quest
ui.HOME_SUBTITLE: Select a dungeon cover to view bosses, loot and quests
ui.ITEM_CLICK_MAP: Click to show it on the map.
ui.ITEM_UNSEEN_TIP: This item is in the game but the server hasn't sent its details yet. They'll show up once someone has seen it (for example after it drops).
ui.LANGUAGE_HELP: Language test: /dj lang de, fr, es, ru, it, pt, ko, zh, zhtw, en, /dj lang auto
ui.LEVEL_TOO_LOW_DUNGEONS:
You are too low level for dungeons.
The first ones start at level %d.
ui.LF_ARMOR_TIP: Hides armor pieces of other types. Weapons, shields, rings, necks, trinkets and cloaks always stay.
ui.LF_CLASS_ONLY: Only show loot my class can use
ui.LF_MATCH_ALL: Item must have all ticked stats
ui.LF_SHOW_TIP: Opens a page listing every boss, in every dungeon, that drops loot matching the filters above.
ui.LF_STATS_HINT: Tick the stats you are looking for. Nothing ticked shows everything.
ui.LOOT_COMPACT_TIP: Show more items at once in smaller rows
ui.LOOT_NOTE_BURNING_FELGUARD: Scarshield Warlocks can summon it through their portals
ui.LOOT_NOTE_HELNURATH: Summoned by the Warlock epic mount quest
ui.MAP_COMBAT: the map can't open during combat. Press %s to see the marked spot.
ui.MAP_LEFT_TARGET: Left Click to target and mark quest giver if nearby
ui.MAP_OBJ_BFD_CHEST: Loot the Lorgalis Manuscript from the Pitted Iron Chest, underwater in this alcove of the pool.
ui.MAP_OBJ_BFD_FATHOM: Click the Fathom Stone underwater, below the walkway, to get the Fathom Core. Baron Aquanis spawns when you do.
ui.MAP_OPEN_FAILED: could not open the recorded map location.
ui.MAP_PATROL: Walks around: the line shows the path
ui.MAP_RFK_VINE: Jump on this vine to reach Roogug
ui.MAP_TOOLTIP: Opens the correct zone and marks the recorded quest-start location.
ui.MAP_WREX_KEYRING: Open with Wrex's Keyring for level %d
ui.MINIMAP_HIDE_CONFIRM:
Hide the Dungeon Journal minimap button?

You can bring it back by typing /dj minimap.
ui.MODE_GAMER_DESC: The full journal: every dungeon, boss, loot table and quest is open from the start.
ui.MODE_RPG_DESC: Dungeons start locked and unlock when you defeat their final boss. A progress bar tracks every dungeon quest you complete.
ui.MODE_SUB: You can change this any time in the options (/dj options) or with /dj mode.
ui.NOTICE_LV30_DATA: New loot and quests for dungeons up to lv 30 are still being discovered. I will update as new data comes out. gl hf
ui.NO_FACTION_QUESTS: No %s quests recorded for this dungeon.
ui.NO_FACTION_QUESTS_TBD: No %s quests known for this dungeon yet. It is new and its quests are still being found.
ui.OPT_AUTO_COMPARE_TIP: Item tooltips in the journal compare with your equipped item right away, without holding Shift.
ui.OPT_BIND_TIP: Click, then press a key. Right-click to clear.
ui.OPT_DISCORD_COPY: Press Ctrl+C to copy the invite link.
ui.OPT_DISCORD_TEXT: Join the Dungeon Journal Discord to report bugs, share new discoveries and get the latest news.
ui.OPT_FOREVER_ONLY_TIP: Show only the dungeons that are new in WoW Forever. Untick it to see every dungeon again.
ui.OPT_HIDE_DONE_TICK: Hide the green checkmark for finished dungeons
ui.OPT_HIDE_DONE_TICK_TIP: Removes the green checkmark shown on the home page before the quest count of a dungeon whose quests you have all completed.
ui.OPT_HIDE_DUNGEON_MAP: Hide Dungeon Map inside the dungeon
ui.OPT_HIDE_DUNGEON_MAP_TIP: When ticked, pressing M inside a dungeon shows the game's normal map instead of the journal's dungeon map.
ui.OPT_HIDE_ITEM_LINE: Hide journal line on item tooltips
ui.OPT_HIDE_ITEM_LINE_TIP: Removes the line that shows which boss or quest an item comes from.
ui.OPT_HIDE_LFG_TIP: Hides the eye button next to Show Location on dungeon pages, which opens Looking For Group on that dungeon. You can also right-click the eye and pick Disable.
ui.OPT_HIDE_MINIMAP_TIP: Type /dj minimap to bring the button back.
ui.OPT_HIDE_OUTLEVELED_TIP: Hides a dungeon from the list once your level is above its level range.
ui.OPT_HIDE_QUESTS_DONE: Auto-hide dungeons with all quests done
ui.OPT_HIDE_QUESTS_DONE_TIP: Hides a dungeon from the list once you have completed every quest your character can do there.
ui.OPT_HIDE_SLEEPING_BAG_TIP: Hides the Sleeping Bag icon on the journal's home page (next to the WoW Forever and Raids icons). You can also right-click the icon and pick Hide. A tracked Sleeping Bag chain keeps its arrow.
ui.OPT_KEY_TAKEN: %s is already bound. Choose an unused key.
ui.OPT_MY_LEVEL_RANGE_TIP: Shows only the dungeons whose level range includes your level (the ranges of the Looking For Group panel).
ui.OPT_NO_COMBAT: Keybinds cannot be changed during combat.
ui.OPT_RESET_SIZE_TIP: Puts the journal back to its normal size and scale.
ui.OPT_RESIZE_TIP: Opens the journal so you can drag its corners to make it bigger.
ui.OPT_RPG_MODE_TIP: Dungeons stay locked until this character defeats their final boss, and a progress bar tracks your dungeon quests.
ui.OPT_SHOW_ALL_CLASS_TIP: Also lists class quests for other classes (for example Warlock or Paladin quests). Off: you only see your own class's quests.
ui.OPT_SHOW_ALL_PROF_TIP: Also list profession quests (Blacksmithing, Mining...) for professions this character doesn't have.
ui.PREVIEW_DATA_SOON: Boss, loot and quest data coming soon.
ui.QUEST_COMPLETED: This earlier quest has been completed.
ui.QUEST_IN_LOG: This earlier quest is in your quest log.
ui.QUEST_NOT_CACHED: Quest text is not currently cached by the client.
ui.RESIZE_CORNER_TIP: Drag to resize. Right-click to reset the size.
ui.RESIZE_TIP: Drag to rescale the window. Right-click to reset.
ui.ROUTE_FP_TARREN_MILL_TEXT: The route detours here so you can pick up the flight path. Afterwards, head back down the road and continue east toward Arathi.
ui.RPG_BOSS_HIDDEN: Defeat this boss to reveal it.
ui.RPG_CONFIRM_TEXT: In this mode dungeons will be locked until you kill the final boss. You can always change mode in the options panel.
ui.RPG_INTRO_TEXT:
Dungeons stay locked until you kill their final boss.
You can still choose to show quests in the Options panel.
ui.RPG_LOCKED_CARD: Kill the last boss of a dungeon to unlock the Journal Page
ui.RPG_LOCKED_MSG: This dungeon is locked. Defeat its final boss to unlock it.
ui.RPG_LOCKED_TIP: Defeat %s, the final boss of %s, to unlock this page.
ui.RPG_LOCKED_TIP2: Kill the final boss of the dungeon to unlock this page.
ui.RPG_LOCKED_TIP_QUEST: Picking up one of its quests opens part of it.
ui.RPG_MAP_LOCKED_MSG: The dungeon map unlocks after clearing about 20%% of its trash (%d/%d).
ui.RPG_MAP_LOCKED_TIP: Clear about 20%% of the dungeon's trash to unlock it: %d/%d.
ui.RPG_MAP_TOAST_HINT: Click to open the map in the journal
ui.RPG_MAP_TOAST_HINT_M: Press M in the dungeon to see it
ui.RPG_PROGRESS_PAGES: %d of %d journal pages unlocked (final bosses defeated).
ui.RPG_PROGRESS_POINTS: Each quest is worth %d points, each journal page %d.
ui.RPG_PROGRESS_TIP: %d of %d dungeon quests completed for your faction and class.
ui.RPG_QUEST_HIDDEN: Pick up this quest to unlock it.
ui.RPG_QUEST_TOAST_HINT: Click to open it in the journal
ui.RPG_SUBTITLE: Defeat a dungeon's final boss to unlock its pages
ui.RPG_TOAST_HINT: Click to open it in the journal
ui.RPG_TRASH_HIDDEN: Clear about 20% of the dungeon's trash to reveal it.
ui.RPG_UNLOCKED_MSG: %s is now unlocked in your journal!
ui.SHAREABLE_SAME_STEP: Shareable to players on the same step.
ui.SHOW_WHOLE_CHAIN: Click to show the whole quest chain
ui.SUMMON_QUEST_NOTE: %s has to be summoned: use the %s at the gong by his pool.
ui.TRACK_CLICK: Click to open it in the journal
ui.TRACK_TIP: Shows this dungeon's quests on your screen with your progress. Drag it anywhere.
ui.UPDATE_AVAILABLE: Version %s is available (you have %s). Update on CurseForge.
